title: porxie: 0.3.1 -> 0.3.3, nixos/porxie: update options for version
reason: Real option removal: settings.PORXIE_BLOB_HTTP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT and 4 sibling *_HTTP_*_TIMEOUT options removed from the freeform settings submodule; rest of diff is description-text-only changes.
targets_toml: Self-corrected twice: first attempt option_prefix=[services,porxie,settings] watch=[PORXIE_BLOB_HTTP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT] returned 0 discovered_options (wrong -- settings submodule not walkable when named directly as the prefix tail). Second attempt option_prefix=[services,porxie] with watch as two separate array entries incorrectly targeted PORXIE_BLOB_HTTP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT as a TOP-LEVEL option (not nested under settings), giving false OptionNotFound at BOTH base and head. Final corrected form: option_prefix=[services,porxie], watch=['settings.PORXIE_BLOB_HTTP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT'] (single dotted-path watch string) -- this correctly resolved the nested submodule option. All prior (wrong) targeting attempts and their outputs are VOID.
